prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] At dusk in an open-plan office, a departing coworker waves to <Subject 1> at his desk; he looks up, meets the coworker's eyes, gives a small polite nod and returns to his laptop.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off and restrained contrast, in cool blue-gray tones with the last orange light of sunset on the horizon.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of a contemporary open-plan office at dusk. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind show a skyline of glass towers under a fading blue sky with a thin band of orange at the horizon. <Subject 1> sits at his desk in the right third of the frame, framed from the waist up and turned three-quarters toward the left, his face sharp and clearly lit. On the desk are an open silver laptop, a white ceramic coffee mug with a handle to its right (not a paper cup) and a closed black notebook. At the start, his eyes are on the laptop screen, reading, with one blink. A coworker, a young man in a light-blue shirt with a black bag over his shoulder, walks from the right behind the desks toward the exit on the left and raises a hand in a friendly wave as he passes. <Subject 1> lifts his eyes from the screen to the coworker's face, follows him for a moment with a small turn of the head, and gives a small, polite nod with a brief closed-mouth smile that fades quickly; then his eyes return to the laptop screen. Both of his eyes stay level and symmetrical, pupils aimed at the same target, and his facial proportions stay unchanged as his head turns. He never looks into the lens. In the softly blurred background, two other coworkers pack up at their own pace: one zips a bag, the other pushes in a chair and walks away a moment later; nobody moves in sync, and every person keeps a clear, stable silhouette. The camera holds a static shot. His lips stay closed; he does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame, and the screens show no readable content.

overall_soundscape: Quiet office ventilation hums under faint keyboard clicks, a bag zipper, a chair rolling in and distant footsteps toward the exit.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
